tasks.action: Trace HR pages through workforce/identity/DSH dependencies; correct owner boundaries and verify suspend/reactivate/assignment/readback scenarios.
mustNotChange: Do not create parallel domain truth or client-trusted authorization context.
Do not broaden execution into repository areas without a proven Control Panel dependency.
Do not weaken audit, idempotency, conflict or canonical-readback guarantees to make the UI appear successful.
acceptanceCriteria: Field/Captain eligibility and profile status gate downstream access consistently without local Control Panel truth.
Forbidden/wrong-scope and dependency/error states fail explicitly rather than fabricating success.
State-changing actions are verified by canonical readback and directly affected surfaces where applicable.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused implementation commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving audit/data evidence; never restore parallel truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U004 implementation commit after owner correction, affected-consumer migration, cleanup and linked checks.
